design_principles: Use exact Unit Assessment Plan goal identities.
Consume canonical Exit evidence allocation rather than reallocate it.
Select Question Structure by semantic fit, not variety quota.
Construction tasks use answer-neutral response surfaces.
Mixed-representation tasks route every named representation.
Secure forms vary on meaningful evidence axes; wording/names/values alone are insufficient.
